test_verify_skippables_matching: test that verify_skippables passes when a stash layer is followed by a matching pop layer
test_verify_skippables_stash_not_pop: test that verify_skippables raises TypeError when a stashed tensor has no corresponding pop layer
test_verify_skippables_pop_unknown: test that verify_skippables raises TypeError when a pop layer references a tensor that was never stashed
test_verify_skippables_namespace_isolati: test that Namespace and isolate allow duplicate stash-pop pairs when isolated into separate namespaces
test_skippable_decorator_stash_pop: test the skippable decorator with stash and pop parameters to define skip connection layers
